spec.title: Flow Control Lagged Episode Duration
spec.description: Mean duration of flow-control lagged episodes observed during each rolling 5-minute interval. This is not replica-set replication lag. Primary only.

spec.title: Operation Latency Behavior
spec.description: MongoDB server-side mean latency over a rolling 1-minute interval. Use YCSB output as the authoritative client-perceived latency.

spec.title: MongoDB Operations Ratio
spec.description: Current ratio of MongoDB operation types over the last 5 minutes.

spec.title: TCMalloc Memory Usage
spec.description: TCMalloc allocated memory, heap size, and thread-cache usage. Compare these signals between THP-enabled and THP-disabled runs.

spec.title: TCMalloc Free and Unmapped Memory
spec.description: TCMalloc free memory held by allocator caches and memory returned to the operating system. Useful for identifying THP-related fragmentation or retention.

spec.title: TCMalloc Cache Breakdown
spec.description: Free memory retained by TCMalloc central, thread, and transfer caches. Compare allocator retention and fragmentation between THP modes.

spec.title: WiredTiger Eviction State
spec.description: Current eviction state and worker activity. Eviction state is a WiredTiger state code; sustained worker activity indicates cache pressure.

spec.title: WiredTiger Eviction Triggers
spec.description: Rates of dirty-content and eviction-trigger events. Spikes indicate the cache is reaching configured pressure thresholds.

spec.title: WiredTiger Eviction Activity
spec.description: Rates of pages entering eviction queues and pages evicted from the cache.

spec.title: WiredTiger Dirty Data Rate
spec.description: Rate at which bytes become dirty in the WiredTiger cache.

spec.title: MongoDB Flow Control State
spec.description: Primary-only replication flow-control state and lagged-event rate.

spec.title: MongoDB Flow Control Acquisition Time
spec.description: Primary-only time spent acquiring flow-control tickets and mean acquisition time per lagged event.

spec.title: WiredTiger Cache Fill Over Time
spec.description: WiredTiger cache occupancy as a 0..1 ratio over the benchmark interval.

spec.title: WiredTiger Dirty Cache Ratio
spec.description: Current tracked dirty bytes divided by configured WiredTiger cache size. Requires mongodb_ss_wt_cache_tracked_dirty_bytes_in_the_cache.

spec.title: Replica Set Replication Lag
spec.description: Primary optime minus each secondary optime in seconds. Uses mongodb_rs_members_optimeDate from the mongodb_exporter replicasetstatus collector.

spec.title: Anonymous Huge Pages
spec.description: Host-wide anonymous memory currently backed by transparent huge pages. This confirms actual THP use rather than configuration alone.

spec.title: THP Fault Allocations and Fallbacks
spec.description: Transparent huge-page allocations and allocation fallbacks per second, collected by mongodb_exporter system metrics. Fallbacks indicate that the kernel could not satisfy a huge-page fault.

spec.title: THP Collapse and Split Activity
spec.description: khugepaged collapse successes/failures and huge-page split activity per second, collected by mongodb_exporter system metrics. Missing series indicate counters not exposed by this kernel/exporter combination.

spec.title: MongoDB Operations per Watt
spec.description: Primary MongoDB non-command operation rate divided by measured TuringPi cluster power. Use YCSB throughput/W for publication-quality summaries.

spec.title: WiredTiger Cache Fill %
spec.description: Current WiredTiger cache occupancy. Thresholds use the panel's 0..1 ratio scale.

spec.title: WiredTiger Cache I/O
spec.description: Bytes read into and written from the WiredTiger cache per second. Sustained reads help distinguish cache pressure from a cache-resident workload.
